learningObjective: Understand triton.autotune configurations and their interaction with kernel launch keys.
stem: Consider the Triton autotuned matmul-like kernel below. Which statements about `triton.autotune` are correct? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: `num_warps` and `num_stages` are per-Config launch parameters (warps per program, pipelining stages) that the autotuner selects together with the tile-size constants; they are not free-form Python arguments.
The autotuner runs at compile time only; once the module is loaded, it never re-tunes even if the caller launches with previously-unseen key values.

`triton.autotune` guarantees that the selected config is globally optimal because it exhaustively searches all possible `(BM, BN, BK, num_warps, num_stages)` combinations, not just the user-provided list.

For each distinct combination of the `key` arguments (here `(M, N, K)`), the autotuner measures each config once, caches the best one, and reuses it for subsequent launches with the same key values; new key values trigger a fresh tuning pass.

explanation: `triton.autotune` runs measurement over the user-provided `configs` list, keyed on the specified `key=[...]` arguments; for each new key tuple, it benchmarks each config once and caches the winner. `num_warps` and `num_stages` are structural launch parameters selected per Config (not free-form user args at call time). The autotuner is _not_ exhaustive over the entire configuration space — it only tries the configs the user listed. And it does re-tune when new key values appear; it is a runtime-invoked mechanism, not compile-time-only.

optionExplanations.B: Wrong: autotuner runs at runtime for new key tuples.
optionExplanations.C: Wrong: search is limited to the user-listed configs, not globally exhaustive.

assumptions: The kernel is launched with varying (M, N, K) tuples in practice.
nonImplications: Does not imply the tuning cache is persistent across processes (in-memory by default).
Does not imply autotune measurement is noise-free; noisy measurements can select a suboptimal config.
